title: Acronym Generator
description: Turn any phrase into an acronym instantly — first letters, with options to skip small words, add periods and force uppercase.
howto: Type one phrase per line (e.g. North Atlantic Treaty Organization).
Toggle options: skip small words like "of" and "the", add periods, force uppercase.
Copy any acronym from the results table with one click.

faqs.q: What is the difference between an acronym and an initialism?
faqs.a: An acronym is pronounced as a word (NASA); an initialism is spoken letter by letter (FBI). This tool builds the letter sequence for both.
When enabled, small filler words are skipped: a, an, the, of, and, or, in, on, at, to, for, with, by, from, as, is, are.

faqs.q: Can I process many phrases at once?
faqs.a: Yes — put one phrase per line and every line gets its own acronym in the results table.
